name: Freedom Flex
balance_transfer_fee: Intro fee of either $5 or 3% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater, on transfers made within 60 days of account opening. After that, either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater
penalty_apr_trigger: Failing to make a Minimum Payment when due, or making a payment that's returned unpaid; can remain in effect indefinitely
pay_over_time_fee: 0% during the 0% intro Purchase APR period, then up to 1.72% per month of the amount selected to pay over time

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $500 in purchases in the first 3 months from account opening

verdict.text: Great if you'll activate the rotating 5%; a chore otherwise

earn_rates.category: Quarterly rotating category. This quarter (Q4): Grocery stores (excluding Walmart and Target), dining, American Red Cross

earn_note: You need to opt in every quarter, and missing the activation window drops you back to the base 1%. Combined spend is capped at $1,500 per quarter, so the most you can get back is $75. Full 2026 calendar: Q1 was Norwegian Cruise Line and dining, Q2 was Amazon and Chase Travel, Q3 was gas stations and EV charging, public transit, select live entertainment, and United Way donations, and Q4 is grocery stores (excluding Walmart and Target), dining, and American Red Cross donations. The Q4 activation deadline is Dec 14, 2026. Q1 2027 is grocery stores (excluding Walmart and Target) and top streaming services.

redemption_options.method: Statement credit / direct deposit / cash back

points.note: Technically Ultimate Rewards points, not a distinct cash-back currency; on their own they're worth a flat 1¢ each. Pairing this account with a Chase Sapphire or Ink Business card lets the combined points inherit that card's full redemption value, including airline/hotel transfers.

transfer_partners.highlight: Not a standalone transfer currency on its own; see the points note above on pairing with a premium Chase card.

credits.name: DoorDash DashPass
credits.subtitle: 6 mo free, then $10/quarter promo
credits.description: 6 months of complimentary DashPass membership ($0 delivery fees on DoorDash/Caviar), which then auto-renews at the regular paid rate unless canceled. Separately, up to $10/quarter in statement credits on non-restaurant (grocery/retail) DoorDash orders through Dec 2029.
tips: Cancel DashPass before the 6-month free trial ends if you don't want to start paying for it; it auto-enrolls at the regular rate.
The $10/quarter non-restaurant credit is the only ongoing recurring value here; the free DashPass trial is one-time.

insurance.detail: $60,000 · secondary in the US, primary abroad
+1 year (on warranties ≤3 years, up to 4 years total)

protection_note: Chase discontinued cell phone protection on this card on Sep 20, 2026, so its protections are now basically identical to the fee-free Freedom Unlimited. Trip cancellation and purchase protection are modest, and rental coverage is secondary in the US.
rental_note: Secondary in the US: it pays after your personal auto insurance, covering what's left. Primary outside the US, up to $60,000 and 31 consecutive days. Use a card with primary US coverage for rentals when possible.

services.name: No foreign transaction fees
services.detail: Chase removed this fee on Sep 21, 2026. Purchases outside the US carry no foreign transaction fee.

services.name: Lyft bonus
services.detail: 2% total cash back on Lyft rides through Sep 30, 2027 (an extra 1% on top of the 1% base).

services.name: Chase Pay Over Time
services.detail: Option to pay eligible purchases of $100 or more over 3 to 24 months with a fixed monthly fee and no interest.

services.name: Travel & emergency assistance
services.detail: Legal and medical referrals while traveling; cardholder pays for any goods or services obtained.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Earns rewards on their spend (into your account)
Same purchase protection as the primary card

additional_cards.note: No cost to add users, but remember only one activation covers the whole account for the rotating 5% categories each quarter.

timeline.text: Complimentary cell phone protection is discontinued (losses after Sep 19, 2026 aren't covered). Foreign transaction fees were removed on Sep 21, 2026, so this is a mixed change, not a pure cut.
The Lyft 2% total cash back bonus is scheduled to expire; the DoorDash $10/quarter non-restaurant credit expires Dec 31, 2029.
Freedom Flex launches as a new Mastercard World Elite product alongside a refreshed Freedom Unlimited, introducing rotating 5% categories plus 3% dining/drugstore and cell phone protection.
